required_consumer_behavior: Link model, agent and tool evidence to API request/receipt/event/readback nodes without treating model or trace output as business truth.
Preserve authenticated tenant/purpose authorization and reject cross-tenant or cyclic evidence graphs.
Return bounded protected evidence references rather than prompt, memory, credential or customer content.
Return exact Sultan adoption evidence through a versioned handoff.
known_limitations: No durable universal evidence retrieval route exists.
